issue.title: Command Mode bank runs never refresh bank UI: catalog emits no "bank" invalidation tag though bob-ledger-tools listens for it
issue.description: bob-ledger-tools handles tag === "bank" on bob-command-mode:run-finished (plugins/bob-ledger-tools/src/283-plugin-command-mode-refresh.js:51, calling apiBankInvalidate("command-mode") to refresh Bank Badges, bank cards, and ]b walk state), but bob-cli KNOWN_INVALIDATES (src/native/catalog/table.rs:31) omits "bank" and the bank-import row (table.rs:1349) — like bank-ack and bank-ensure — declares invalidates: &[]. The listener is dead code: a bank import, ack, or ensure run from Command Mode never refreshes bank UI. Fix: add "bank" to KNOWN_INVALIDATES and set invalidates: &["bank"] on the bank write rows (bank-import at minimum; consider bank-ack/bank-ensure), then verify with the bob-plugins command-mode refresh test. Independently corroborated: the __gem swarm report found the same seam and the lead researcher verified both sides in the checkouts (research:202611/bank_import_delete_flag/bank_import_delete_flag__final.md).

task_type_fields.impact: Bank Badges, bank cards, and ]b walk state stay stale after every Command Mode bank write until some other invalidation fires; the planned bank import -D flow makes this more visible since the weekly import becomes a one-click Command Mode gesture.
task_type_fields.repro: grep -n "KNOWN_INVALIDATES" -A 8 src/native/catalog/table.rs shows no "bank" entry and the bank-import writes() row sets no invalidates, while grep -n "bank" plugins/bob-ledger-tools/src/283-plugin-command-mode-refresh.js shows the tag handler; run any bank write from Command Mode and observe bank badges/cards do not refresh.

issue.creation_reason: Found while consolidating the bank import -D research swarm: the plugin listener and the catalog disagree, so every Command Mode bank write leaves stale bank UI until another refresh path fires.

payload.entry: Resolved by bob-cli-no.1 commit 5b547f13: all bank-import, bank-ack and bank-ensure rows emit bank; current installed __catalog --protocol 1 confirms all three, matching current source. On plugins c3ca244, focused command-mode refresh, Bank card and Keep inbox suites pass 65/65, including bank invalidation wiring.
